blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The province has recorded 1,424 dengue cases, including three deaths, as of Oct. 13, according to the Provincial Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (PESU). The PESU dengue dashboard showed 117 newly reported cases from Oct. 4 to 10, prompting the provincial government and local health authorities to intensify dengue prevention efforts. The Provincial Health Office, in coordination with local government units, municipal health offices and barangays, has been implementing measures, including public information campaigns, community cleanups and the removal of mosquito breeding sites.
